propositions: runner.py exceeds the 800-LOC module-size soft cap and must be graduated off the gate by extracting a cohesive leaf module.
The anthropic-model construction cluster plus provider/model-resolution and cache helpers are moved verbatim into a new sibling leaf anthropic_model.py.
Heavy libraries stay as lazy in-function imports to preserve the stdlib-only import rebar.llm contract, and the leaf imports nothing back from runner.py.
runner.py re-exports the 5 externally referenced names and run() calls them by bare name to keep the monkeypatch test seam working.
Graduation requires removing runner.py from the allowlist and ceilings files and deleting its architecture.md offenders remedy row.
This is a pure mechanical refactor with no signature or logic change, validated by existing tests as the oracle.
